stories.title: AI 生成的 2.5 小时《奥德赛》电影被批太长、太差
stories.sourceTitle: The 2.5-hour AI-generated Odyssey movie is 2.5 hours too long
stories.summary: The Verge 批评一部完全由 AI 生成的《奥德赛》改编电影长达 2.5 小时，质量差到可能让观众讨厌原著；此前克里斯托弗·诺兰的《奥德赛》电影刚带动了古典文学热度。
stories.analysis: 生成式 AI 能做长片不等于能做好电影，叙事、表演和审美仍是硬门槛。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Christopher Nolan's engrossing take on The Odyssey dominated at the box office and spurred a newfound interest in classic literature among filmgoers. But a new retelling of the story made entirely with AI is so bad that it might just make viewers hate the orig

stories.title: 报告警告：AI 数据中心电子垃圾被严重低估，2050 年可装满 2300 万个集装箱
stories.sourceTitle: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
stories.summary: The Verge 报道新报告称，AI 热潮带来的电子垃圾远超此前估计，到 2050 年可能多到填满 2300 万个 40 英尺集装箱，连起来可绕地球六圈。
stories.analysis: AI 算力扩张的环境成本正从能耗延伸到硬件废弃，数据中心可持续性会成为监管与选址的新焦点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: E-waste from the AI boom has been vastly underestimated, a new report warns. By 2050, it could become enough trash to fill 23 million shipping containers - roughly enough 40-foot containers to circle the world six times if lined up in a row. It's a significant

stories.title: OpenAI 发布模型失准报告框架，并披露六起异常行为
stories.sourceTitle: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
stories.summary: OpenAI 公布一套跟踪、调查和披露模型失准的框架，同时发布六份关于模型意外或令人担忧行为的报告。
stories.analysis: 主动披露失准行为有助于建立信任，但关键在披露标准是否透明、可验证，以及是否会被用于规避更严格的外部监管。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.

stories.title: Anthropic 和 OpenAI 想嵌入独立安全评估员，但独立性引质疑
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic and OpenAI want to embed safety evaluators. Will they really be independent?
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道两家 AI 实验室计划让独立安全评估员进入内部，研究者欢迎这种前所未有的访问权，但警告有效监督仍需透明度、独立性和最终监管。
stories.analysis: 把评估员请进实验室是进步，但若没有外部授权和问责机制，“独立”容易变成公关姿态。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic and OpenAI want to embed independent safety evaluators inside their AI labs. Researchers welcome the unprecedented access, but warn meaningful oversight requires transparency, independence, and eventually regulation.

stories.title: OpenAI 与 AARP 合作，在 10 座美国城市为 1000 名老年人办 ChatGPT 工作坊
stories.sourceTitle: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
stories.summary: OpenAI 和 AARP 推出免费线下 ChatGPT 工作坊，覆盖美国 10 个城市的 1000 名老年人，帮助他们安全掌握实用 AI 技能。
stories.analysis: 这是 AI 普及从年轻早期用户走向大众的一步，老年群体的信任与安全使用会决定 AI 能否真正融入日常生活。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.

stories.title: 被指卖“偷窥眼镜”后，Meta 准备推出无摄像头版本智能眼镜
stories.sourceTitle: After accusations of selling ‘perv glasses,’ Meta prepares to sell a pair without a camera
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，在 Meta 智能眼镜因隐私争议被批为“偷窥眼镜”后，公司准备推出一款不带摄像头的产品，试图挽回公众信任。
stories.analysis: 去掉摄像头能缓解隐私反弹，但也可能削弱 Meta 眼镜最核心的卖点，考验其能否用非拍摄场景重新定义产品价值。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Can Meta dodge the "pervert glasses" accusations with a new camera-free product?

stories.title: OpenAI 推出 AI 广告新玩法：Sponsored Agents、营销工具并接入 HubSpot 和 Shopify
stories.sourceTitle: Reimagining advertising with AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 展示 AI 驱动的广告体验，包括 Sponsored Agents、面向营销人员的工具，以及与 HubSpot 和 Shopify 的集成。
stories.analysis: 把广告做成智能代理意味着 OpenAI 正探索对话式商业变现，但也会让“助手推荐”与“付费推广”的边界更受审视。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

stories.title: Apple 可能重返服务器制造，或与 NVIDIA 合作抓住 AI 热潮
stories.sourceTitle: Apple might make servers again to cash in on the AI rush
stories.summary: The Information 称 Apple 计划重返服务器市场，并可能与 NVIDIA 合作；Apple 曾在 2011 年停产 Xserve，此后基本退出企业服务器。
stories.analysis: 若 Apple 借自研芯片或 NVIDIA 算力重回服务器，它可能补齐 AI 云基础设施短板，也会改变其与云厂商和芯片供应商的关系。
stories.sourceExcerpt: According to The Information, Apple is planning to get back into the server game and might just pair up with Nvidia to make it happen. Apple retired its Xserve line in 2011 and has largely left enterprise machines to other manufacturers since. But the growing

stories.title: Google 开放 Google Home，让 Claude、Open Claw 等 AI Agent 控制智能家居
stories.sourceTitle: Google will now let any AI agent run your smart home
stories.summary: Google 通过标准化的 Model Context Protocol 开放智能家居，让第三方 AI Agent 访问和控制联网设备，并分析家庭数据。
stories.analysis: MCP 把智能家居从 App 控制推向 Agent 控制，但设备权限、隐私和误操作风险会随开放性同步放大。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google is opening up its smart home to AI agents, letting tools like Claude and Open Claw access and control your connected devices and analyze your home's data using the standardized Model Context Protocol. Google Home MCP is a new integration that lets third

stories.title: Claude 推出 Docs 和 Slides，正面挑战 Google Gemini
stories.sourceTitle: Claude comes for Gemini with its own take on Docs and Slides
stories.summary: Anthropic 为 Claude 增加 Docs 和 Slides，用户可在 Claude 对话中创建文档和演示文稿，并导出、编辑和分享；同时简化 Claude 的使用方式。
stories.analysis: Claude 从聊天助手扩展到办公套件，直接对标 Gemini 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot，办公场景的 AI 入口争夺更激烈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Claude is getting a pair of new tools today: Docs and Slides. They'll let you create documents and presentations through Claude chats, which you can export, edit, and share with other users. As part of the announcement, Anthropic is also simplifying how Claude

stories.title: AI 实验室想要内部审计员，但也许该先关好前门
stories.sourceTitle: AI labs want in-house auditors — but maybe they should shut the front door first
stories.summary: TechCrunch 评论称，面对失控 Agent，AI 实验室推动内部审计，但更简单有效的修复可能被忽视：先限制和堵住系统入口。
stories.analysis: 内部审计很重要，但如果 Agent 权限和访问控制本身有漏洞，事后审计只能记录问题，不能阻止问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: There may be a simpler and more effective fix for rogue agents, hiding in plain sight.

stories.title: OpenAI 教你用 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 分析，把 AI 使用量连到业务价值
stories.sourceTitle: How to connect AI usage to business value
stories.summary: OpenAI 介绍如何通过 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 分析帮助团队理解 AI 使用与支出、识别培训需求，并把采用情况与业务成果关联。
stories.analysis: 企业 AI 采购正从“买了多少席位”转向“产生了什么结果”，分析工具会成为续费和扩购的关键依据。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams understand AI usage and spend, identify training needs, and connect adoption to business outcomes.

stories.title: SK Hynix 据称与 Intel 洽谈在美国建内存芯片厂
stories.sourceTitle: SK Hynix reportedly in talks with Intel to build memory chips in US
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道 SK Hynix 正与 Intel 洽谈在美国生产内存芯片，但 SK Hynix 表示尚未最终确定任何计划或安排。
stories.analysis: 若成真，这会进一步推动 AI 内存供应链本土化，也可能改变 HBM 和传统 DRAM 的地缘产能布局。
stories.sourceExcerpt: SK Hynix told TechCrunch the company hasn't finalized any plans or arrangements yet.

stories.title: AI 驱动的“性感”约会 App 骗局已经来了
stories.sourceTitle: The sexy AI-powered dating app scams are here
stories.summary: The Verge 报道安全研究员 Matthew “Zigula” Gore-Kormanik 在分析欺诈约会 App Dora 时，收到自称 Jennifer 的来电弹窗，揭示 AI 如何被用于伪造约会对象和诈骗。
stories.analysis: 生成式 AI 让婚恋诈骗更廉价、更逼真，平台验证、用户教育和支付风控需要同步升级。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Security researcher Matthew "Zigula" Gore-Kormanik was analyzing a fraudulent dating app called Dora when he got a pop-up message saying he was receiving a call from Jennifer. According to her bio, she's a 41-year-old Sagittarius with red hair, blue eyes, and

stories.title: 你的 AI Agent 现在可以控制 Google Home 设备
stories.sourceTitle: Your AI agents can now control your Google Home devices
stories.summary: Google 推出 Google Home MCP 服务器早期访问，允许 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI Agent 用自然语言控制联网设备、查看摄像头摘要和智能家居活动。
stories.analysis: 与 The Verge 同题，这显示 Google 选择开放生态而非封闭控制，MCP 正成为智能家居 Agent 接入的事实标准之一。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google is launching early access to a new MCP server for Google Home, allowing AI agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and others to control connected devices, review camera summaries, and access smart home activity using natural language.

stories.title: Anthropic 把 Claude 聊天和 Cowork 合并到一个界面
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic merges Claude chat and Cowork in one interface
stories.summary: Anthropic 将 Claude 聊天和 Cowork 整合到统一界面，初期面向 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户开放。
stories.analysis: 这能降低用户在对话与协作模式间切换的成本，也表明 Anthropic 正把 Claude 打造成更完整的工作台。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic is initially releasing these features to Pro and Max plan subscribers.

stories.title: AI 高管呼吁监管简史：Sam Altman、Dario Amodei、Demis Hassabis 都曾发声
stories.sourceTitle: A brief history of AI executives calling for regulation
stories.summary: The Verge 梳理近年 AI 高管公开呼吁监管的言论，包括 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman、Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 和 Google DeepMind 联合创始人 Demis Hassabis 等人，称应在大失控前让大家慢下来。
stories.analysis: 高管呼吁监管既可能出于真诚安全担忧，也可能是抢占规则制定权；关键是看他们是否支持有约束力的具体法案。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Over the past few days, a lot of people who stand to make a lot of money from AI all publicly agreed that it's time to make everyone slow down before we lose control - including OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, Google DeepMind cofounder Demis

stories.title: OpenAI 经济研究：员工如何用 AI 解锁新工作方式
stories.sourceTitle: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
stories.summary: OpenAI 新经济研究展示员工如何在传统角色之外使用 AI，以及哪些新活动正成为工作中的重复性环节。
stories.analysis: 这有助于衡量 AI 对岗位任务的实际重构，而不只是看自动化替代率。
stories.sourceExcerpt: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.

stories.title: NVIDIA 的 Les Karpas 将在 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 解释：机器人为何还在等 ChatGPT 时刻
stories.sourceTitle: Robots are waiting for a ChatGPT moment: Nvidia’s Les Karpas explains why at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，NVIDIA 的 Les Karpas 将在 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 上解释机器人产业为何仍未迎来日常生活中的突破时刻；9 月 25 日前注册可省最多 200 美元。
stories.analysis: 机器人缺少的不只是模型，还有数据、硬件成本和通用操作能力，NVIDIA 的视角值得关注其如何定义下一个拐点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The robotics industry is still waiting for their breakthrough into day-to-day life. Nvidia's Les Karpas has an answer as to why at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register before September 25 to save up to $200 on your pass.

stories.title: Threads 推出播客新功能：个人资料卡、节目链接、转录和受众洞察
stories.sourceTitle: Threads’ new features let podcasters promote shows and reach listeners
stories.summary: Threads 为播客创作者推出资料卡、单集链接、转录、嘉宾标签、发帖提醒和受众洞察，希望把平台做成播客推广与讨论中心，与 X 竞争。
stories.analysis: 这并非纯 AI 新闻，但 Meta 正用创作者工具增强 Threads 粘性，AI 可能在转录和推荐中扮演底层角色。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Threads is rolling out new tools for podcasters, including profile cards, episode links, transcripts, guest tags, posting reminders, and audience insights, as Meta looks to make the X rival a bigger hub for podcast promotion and discussion.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 公布第二批 VC 评委，将评审 Startup Battlefield 200
stories.sourceTitle: Next wave of VCs judging Startup Battlefield 200 contenders at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 revealed
stories.summary: TechCrunch 公布下一批五位顶级投资人，他们将在 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 现场评审 Startup Battlefield 200；9 月 25 日前注册可省最多 200 美元。
stories.analysis: 这是创业赛事和融资风向标，评委阵容变化可反映资本当前关注的 AI 与科技赛道。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meet the next five top-tier investors judging the Startup Battlefield 200 contenders live at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register before September 25 to save up to $200 and don't miss a moment of the ultimate startup pitch competition.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 参展报名还剩 3 天，可面向 VC 和高价值客户展示品牌
stories.sourceTitle: 3 days left to exhibit: Get your brand in front of VCs and high-value leads at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: TechCrunch 提醒 Disrupt 2026 参展桌预订截止 9 月 18 日，只剩 3 天；活动将于 10 月 13 日至 15 日吸引 10000 多名创始人、投资人、运营者和科技领袖。
stories.analysis: 这类展会仍是 AI 初创集中获客和融资曝光的线下渠道，尤其适合需要验证企业客户的早期公司。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Last day to book your exhibit table at Disrupt is September 18. Three days left. Get your startup in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, operators, and tech leaders on October 13–15.

stories.title: 前 Infosys 首席执行官的 AI 初创公司再融 5300 万美元
stories.sourceTitle: Former Infosys chief’s AI startup nabs another $53M
stories.summary: 这家位于 Palo Alto 的初创公司称，在推出后数月内已拿下多笔七位数企业合同，并完成新一轮 5300 万美元融资。
stories.analysis: 企业 AI 采购正在向有行业背景和落地合同的团队集中，创始团队资历仍能显著影响融资能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The Palo Alto startup says it has landed multiple seven-figure enterprise contracts within months of launch.

stories.title: Amazon 在印度推出 Alexa+，支持印地语
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon launches Alexa+ in India with Hindi support
stories.summary: Amazon 在印度上线 Alexa+ 助手，并在早期访问阶段向所有客户开放，支持印地语。
stories.analysis: 本地语言支持是语音助手在非英语市场落地的关键，印度庞大用户群也会成为 Amazon 与 Google 竞争的新战场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon is letting all customers use Alexa+ assistant in early access period.

stories.title: 多项民调显示：AI 和数据中心极不受欢迎
stories.sourceTitle: AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular in every poll
stories.summary: The Verge 援引《纽约时报》和 Siena University 周二发布的民调称，AI 和数据中心建设在美国民众中极不受欢迎，政客正在对此作出反应。
stories.analysis: 公众情绪已成为 AI 基础设施扩张的现实阻力，数据中心选址、电价和社区沟通将越来越政治化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Poll data released Tuesday by The New York Times and Siena University confirms what we've already been seeing, and what politicians are responding to - AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular. Asked if they support or oppose the construction of data cente

stories.title: 亚马逊 CTO 要来中国了，说实话，这比泛滥的 AI 发布会值得关注
stories.sourceTitle: 亚马逊 CTO 要来中国了，说实话，这比泛滥的 AI 发布会值得关注
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文 报道，亚马逊 CTO 将访问中国，文章认为这比泛滥的 AI 发布会更值得关注。
stories.analysis: 这暗示中国开发者更应关注亚马逊云科技的技术与生态落地，而非营销式发布。

stories.sourceTitle: 通用能力不打折，空间具身智能断层领先！ZDTaichu5.0-9B国产开源，跻身全球多模态第一梯队
stories.summary: 量子位报道，ZDTaichu5.0-9B 在九大空间测试中于 10B 规模通用模型里拿下 8 项第一，号称国产开源多模态模型进入全球第一梯队。
stories.analysis: 如果评测可复现，这说明国产开源多模态在空间具身智能方向形成差异化优势，但真实机器人任务泛化仍需验证。

stories.title: Qwen3Guard：面向 Token 流的实时安全防护

stories.summary: Qwen 团队发布 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型 Qwen3Guard，基于 Qwen3 基础模型微调用于安全分类，可对 token 流做实时安全防护。
stories.analysis: 把安全护栏做成实时 token 级模型，有助于在生成过程中拦截风险，但会面临延迟、误杀和对抗绕过等工程挑战。
